title: Episode 3 - Sone ka laddoo
end_card:
पार्ट 4 कल!
दिवाली में 8 दिन बाकी

shots.visual: Evening at the banyan tree shrine. A glowing golden laddoo sits on a decorated pedestal under a soft warm spotlight, with a crowd of small silhouettes gathered around in awe. Chikki stands in front of it, speaking firmly to the crowd.
shots.camera: slow reveal of the glowing golden laddoo, then medium shot of Chikki

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: ये है सोने का लड्डू, पूरे साल की खुशियाँ इसी में हैं! आज रात मैं खुद इसकी रखवाली करूँगी!

shots.visual: Chikki points firmly at the shrine gate, assigning guard duty. Bhola looks alarmed and scratches his head.
shots.camera: medium two-shot, Chikki pointing, Bhola nervous

lines.speaker: bhola
lines.hi: पर मैं तो सो जाता हूँ!

shots.visual: Deep night, bright moon, at the shrine gate. Kallu lands next to Bhola with a helpful, innocent face. Bhola yawns, slumps against the gate and falls asleep snoring. Kallu waits, then tiptoes away toward the golden laddoo in the background, glancing back with a sly smile.
shots.camera: moonlit medium shot of Bhola and Kallu, then follow Kallu tiptoeing away

lines.speaker: kallu
lines.hi: फिक्र मत कर, मैं साथ हूँ!

shots.visual: Deep night. Chikki hides behind a pot, whispering to Chulbul who is slumped sleepily against the pot with his cap over his eyes, tiny golden smudges on his paws. In the far background a dark shape slips across the shrine toward the pedestal.
shots.camera: wide moonlit shot, slow push toward Chikki and Chulbul while a dark shape crosses behind them

shots.visual: Cliffhanger. Dawn. Chikki lifts the golden laddoo from the pedestal, it feels light, and it cracks in her paw, revealing plain besan inside with golden paint flaking off. Bhola wakes up behind her, sleepy, with golden flakes on his tongue. Chikki slowly turns toward Bhola, eyes narrowing.
shots.camera: close-up of the laddoo cracking open, then slow push in on Chikki's narrowed eyes, then Bhola's guilty face

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: ये तो नकली है! असली लड्डू कहाँ गया?

lines.speaker: bhola
lines.hi: मैंने तो... बस एक बार चाटा था!
